request.spec:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sheet notes are in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**What it does**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V100__sheet_note.sql`, adds a `sheet_note` table. Each note keeps its text, who added it, and the sheet's today when it was added.
- **Server:** a new `note` package (in the same style as void reasons) lets you list and add notes at `/api/sheets/{sheetId}/notes`.
  - A blank note is refused before anything is saved or written to the audit file.
  - A note that goes through writes `NOTE_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> text=<text>`. The ` for=<steward>` ending is added automatically when the user is acting under a delegation.
  - The checks that already exist stop viewers, archived sheets and as-of screens from adding notes.
  - When the screen is showing an as-of date, the list only includes notes added while the sheet's today was on or before that date.
- **Screen:** a new Notes panel on the home screen lists notes newest first as `<date added> <user>: <text>`. It has `note-text`, `note-add`, `note-error` and `note-line` to match the test. The error clears as soon as you change the text.

The test never actually checks the as-of filtering on a sheet that has notes: under an as-of date it only checks that a sheet with no notes shows an empty list. That filtering is in place but not covered by the test.

Notes are not copied when a sheet is cloned, since the request didn't ask for it.
